summary: Dark centered hero with four service link columns and a curved bottom edge, then mostly light sections: reasons slider, a figure and photo mosaic, badge rows, a tech stack tab panel, project slider, a dark contact statement, a quote slider, a video list, a blue news slider, press logos, an FAQ, a blue call bar and a dark office slider.

sections.note: centered two-line headline on a starry dark navy ground, four outlined link columns with bullet lists underneath, curved white edge at the bottom
large heading left with intro paragraph right, three outlined cards with line icons, title and long paragraph, arrows and a pill button below, gradient circles as decoration
mosaic grid of equal square tiles: a text tile with label, heading and paragraph, dark figure tiles and photo tiles mixed, four figures in total
centered label above two rows of round seals and certification badges
heading and short paragraph, vertical list of five category tabs left, grid of small technology logo tiles right with a small arrow
centered label and heading, white project cards with a tall image, title and tags, progress bar and a pill button below
one centered line over a network-pattern dark band with a large round gradient contact button under a thin horizontal rule
large circle image left, right: label, heading, quote text, name and company, bar pagination, oversized quote mark behind
centered heading, big video player left and a scrollable list of video titles with durations right
brand-blue ground: heading top left, slider of dark image cards with date and title overlay, round arrows bottom left and a pill button right
centered label above a single scrolling row of press logos
centered heading, stacked white rows with chevrons on soft shadow, gradient circles behind
wide rounded blue bar with a paper-plane icon and a line left and a gradient pill button right
navy strip with round arrows at both sides and four office columns showing city, phone, address and email, above the footer
